outcome: Normalization of TSH and FT4 levels
cohort: The study included 13 pregnant women with symptomatic thyroid nodules, comprising six with nontoxic cystic, four with nontoxic solid, and three with overt hyperthyroidism caused by toxic nodules.
finding: Percutaneous ethanol injection therapy (PEI) is a safe tool that shows good short-term results in treating selected symptomatic pregnant patients, although long-term success may necessitate repeat PEI.
